# Changelog

## Version 2.0.0

Module `generic_contract_resource_service` was merged in `generic_contract_resource`.


## Version 1.5.0

Added ability to delete contract's Resource SLA line


## Version 1.4.0

Added new contract event: Contract resource added


## Version 1.0.0

Update resource form view: show stat-button to open related contracts
